title: dryopteris augescens var. geropogon
intro: Dryopteris augescens var. geropogon, commonly known as Autumn Fern, is a type of fern plant belonging to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, eczema, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Autumn Fern include its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an antispasmodic, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
